The meta description highlights key value props (Claude-powered, instant answers, voice chat) and includes the free trial and pricing hook to drive clicks. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on social platforms, increasing click-through rates from LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook where business professionals discover tools.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately names the product (Gideon), clarifies what it does (AI assistant for trade and business), and highlights key features (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no commitment, which increases conversion likelihood for first-time visitors.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, and annual plans save you 30 percent. Your free searches give you a genuine feel for how Gideon can support your business decisions—no commitment required.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses a key conversion moment: the transition from free trial to paid membership. It reassures prospects that the free experience is genuine, clarifies pricing without pressure, and highlights the annual savings incentive—reducing friction and objections at the paywall stage.
